name: @fezchat/workflows
description: Deterministic channel automations for fez — reply-triggered handoffs, approval-by-reaction gates, judged conditions; Buzz's workflow engine decentralized. Runs standalone or inside the desktop's background worker.

scripts.build: esbuild src/workflows.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --external:@fezchat/protocol --outfile=dist/workflows.js && esbuild src/defs.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/defs.js && esbuild src/headless.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/headless.js
